units.source_text: 害得我长年忍受相思之苦，忧愁懊恼，不辨前后。”

en.t: It has made me endure the pain of longing for years, sorrowful and tormented, unable to tell what comes before or after."

units.source_text: 他借口酒醉，装出困疲之状。

en.t: He used drunkenness as an excuse and pretended to be worn out and exhausted.

units.source_text: 天色近晓，只当不知，流连不肯归去。

en.t: Though dawn was drawing near, he acted as if he did not know and lingered on, unwilling to go home.
All the waiting women grew anxious on their behalf.

units.source_text: 内大臣闻之，怪道：“睡得这么得意，现在还不起来？”

en.t: When the Inner Minister heard of it, he said in surprise, "Sleeping so contentedly, and still not getting up even now?"

units.source_text: 但夕雾终于在天色大明之前回去，那睡眼蒙眬之相亦甚美观。

en.t: But Yugiri finally returned before full daylight, and his drowsy, blurred-eyed appearance was also very beautiful.
